rag.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
rag.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
rag.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

rag.name: OTel-LLM-E4B-IT
rag.summary: OTel-LLM-E4B-IT是一个面向电信领域的微调语言模型，基于Gemma 4架构。不同于常见的轻量适配器方法，它采用全参数微调，在专业电信数据集OTel上深入训练，既保留了基础模型的通用能力，又嵌入了深厚的领域知识。技术上，该模型专为RAG（检索增强生成）设计，可无缝集成外部知识库，实现精准的上下文感知响应。典型应用包括电信技术支持、客户服务对话、网络故障排查等。开发者可直接部署为对话机器人，或将其作为RAG的基础模型，构建实时电信专家助手。
rag.summary_en: OTel-LLM-E4B-IT is a fine-tuned language model for the telecommunications domain, built on Gemma 4. Unlike lightweight adapters, it uses full-parameter fine-tuning on a specialized telecom dataset (OTel) to deeply embed domain knowledge while preserving general capabilities. It is designed for RAG integration, enabling accurate, context-aware responses for customer support, technical troubleshooting, and network operations. Developers can deploy it as a conversational agent or embed it into RAG pipelines for real-time telecom assistance.

vector_retrieval.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
vector_retrieval.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。
vector_retrieval.summary_en: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a compact BERT-based model optimized for text ranking and semantic search tasks, solving the challenge of efficient information retrieval from large text collections. It employs knowledge distillation to compress a larger teacher model into a smaller arc…

vector_retrieval.name: snowflake-arctic-embed-xs
vector_retrieval.summary: Snowflake Arctic Embed XS是一款极小的文本嵌入模型，专为资源受限环境设计，在保持高质量的同时实现快速推理。它通过蒸馏技术从更大的Arctic Embed模型学习，并支持ONNX和transformers.js，可直接在浏览器或边缘设备运行。技术亮点在于其小巧体积下仍能提供有竞争力的嵌入质量。实践上，你可通过sentence-transformers库轻松集成，用于语义搜索、聚类或分类任务；也可在网页应用中直接调用，实现实时文本相似度计算。尝试用它来为你的移动端应用或低延迟场景构建高效检索系统。
vector_retrieval.summary_en: Snowflake Arctic Embed XS is a compact text embedding model that balances quality with speed, ideal for resource-constrained environments. It uses knowledge distillation from larger Arctic Embed models, and supports ONNX and transformers.js for deployment on edge devices or in browsers. Use it for semantic search, clustering, or classification via sentence-transformers, or integrate directly into web apps for real-time text similarity.

model_distillation.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
model_distillation.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
model_distillation.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

model_distillation.name: snowflake-arctic-embed-xs
model_distillation.summary: Snowflake Arctic Embed XS是一款极小的文本嵌入模型，专为资源受限环境设计，在保持高质量的同时实现快速推理。它通过蒸馏技术从更大的Arctic Embed模型学习，并支持ONNX和transformers.js，可直接在浏览器或边缘设备运行。技术亮点在于其小巧体积下仍能提供有竞争力的嵌入质量。实践上，你可通过sentence-transformers库轻松集成，用于语义搜索、聚类或分类任务；也可在网页应用中直接调用，实现实时文本相似度计算。尝试用它来为你的移动端应用或低延迟场景构建高效检索系统。
model_distillation.summary_en: Snowflake Arctic Embed XS is a compact text embedding model that balances quality with speed, ideal for resource-constrained environments. It uses knowledge distillation from larger Arctic Embed models, and supports ONNX and transformers.js for deployment on edge devices or in browsers. Use it for semantic search, clustering, or classification via sentence-transformers, or integrate directly into web apps for real-time text similarity.

model_quantization.name: tflite
model_quantization.summary: 本库提供了一系列TensorFlow Lite格式的预训练模型，专为移动端、嵌入式及边缘设备优化，实现低延迟、低功耗的本地推理。这些模型经过量化等轻量化技术处理，在保持较高准确率的同时大幅减少计算量和存储占用。开发者可直接下载使用，或参考其转换流程将自有TensorFlow模型转为TFLite格式，从而在手机、摄像头、IoT设备等资源受限环境中快速部署AI应用，如实时图像分类、目标检测和语音识别，同时避免云端传输，保障数据隐私。
model_quantization.summary_en: This repository contains a collection of TensorFlow Lite models optimized for on-device inference. It enables efficient AI deployment on mobile, embedded, and edge devices with minimal latency and power consumption. The models are pre-converted from popular TensorFlow architectures using quantization and optimization techniques. Developers can directly download these ready-to-use models or use them as a reference to convert their own models, enabling real-world applications like image classification and object detection without cloud dependency.

model_compression.summary: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 是一个高效的句子嵌入模型，能将文本转换为有意义的向量表示，用于计算语义相似度。它通过知识蒸馏技术从大型模型中学习，仅用2270万参数就实现了接近大模型的性能，特别适合资源受限环境。开发者可通过Hugging Face快速调用该模型，应用于智能搜索、文档聚类或内容推荐等场景，探索语义理解在实际项目中的潜力。

multilingual_processing.name: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
multilingual_processing.summary: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 是一个紧凑的多语言句子编码模型，专门解决跨语言语义理解难题，支持50多种语言的文本相似度计算。它通过知识蒸馏技术将大型多语言Transformer的能力压缩到轻量级12层架构中，同时保持跨语言语义对齐特性，让模型在不同语言间准确捕捉相同含义。开发者可直接用它构建多语言语义搜索系统、实现跨语言文档分类，或作为特征提取器用于下游NLP任务，只需输入任意支持语言的文本即可获得高质量的语义向量表示。
